summary: game_dialogs 007 (NewExchange): recreate the trade window in the kit
author: pm
body:
The user, 2026-11-25: "007 - we can recreate that".

Sheet 007 (InterfaceNdNewExchange, 526x360, one frame) is the trade window background. It is drawn only by dialog_box_exchange.cpp:40 (draw_new_dialog_box(InterfaceNdNewExchange, sX, sY, 0), as of 2026-11-25). Recreate it with the panel kit at the same size and position, keeping every slot, label and button where it is now. Then remove InterfaceNdNewExchange, make sprite 7 an empty placeholder and archive 007.png.

**Done when:** the trade window draws from the kit with every item slot, label and button in the same place, 007.png is archived byte-identical to working/archive/interface/game_dialogs/ with an empty manifest placeholder, both builds are clean, and in-client screenshots of the trade window are attached.

**Scheduling, 2026-11-25:** user: "Start 0098 after the entire system menu and graphics dialog is done." Blocked by HH-0114.

**Started, 2026-11-26:** HH-0114 is done; editor dispatched.

**Work, 2026-11-26:** Trade window frame rebuilt from the panel kit at 523x356 (draw_exchange_frame in dialog_box_exchange.cpp: kit frame, "Exchange Item" title with divider_wave, two 236x179 kit insets at x 16 and 269, header rule, three column vrules each; item slots, labels and buttons untouched). InterfaceNdNewExchange and its load removed; game_dialogs sprite 7 is an empty manifest placeholder; 007.png archived byte-identical to working/archive/interface/game_dialogs/007_2026-11-26.png (sha256 e20d9281c0789be72b053ffdaf2e4e124f574e65cd8f18a76a1b5aedc57546b1 before and after) and git rm'd. Client builds (0 errors, none of the 80 warnings in touched files), deployed; gen_sprite_index.py --check passes. Static reference-composer preview only (old frame above, kit frame below): .claude/scratch/editor/hh0098/preview.png. In-client screenshots of a live trade still needed.

**Review and commit, 2026-11-26:** review passed (no blocking findings; long comment re-wrapped). Committed 541fb5f5. Archive sha256 e20d9281... matches. Left for the user: an in-client look at a live trade (needs two players) - check the column rules sit clear of the item slots (reviewer: rules 2-4 px left of slot midpoints, copied from the old art).

**Nested insets, 2026-11-26:** user: each side an inset, inside it one inset spanning the four columns over four column insets. Done in 5d65352d (standard shade, columns centred on the slots, names centred in the top inset; review passed). User on the preview: "Looks good!". Left: an in-client look at a live trade (two players).
